answer: An admission auction sells 50 entry slots per epoch, blocking bulk fakes. Each applicant posts a $200 opal bond and bids; only the top 50 clear the ledge and become a vertex in the referral graph, losers refunded. Winners lock it 20 epochs, forfeiting it if proven fake. Forging 1,000 identities costs 1,000 clearing prices plus $200,000 in locked opals, against $40 each per epoch. An honest agent pays once and earns rewards undiluted by fakes.
